title: Model Release Safety Gate
core_conflict: A model release summary says the model can ship, while red-team, policy, and owner evidence require a gated release with safety mitigations.
required_constraints: include contradictory release-readiness summaries and current safety or policy evidence
include workspace files, safety-review emails, task-board mitigation items, and launch calendar windows
include dynamic updates that change red-team, mitigation, or policy status after early rounds
emphasize safety gate evaluation, release blocking, and evidence matrix reasoning
